previously McKinsey, @georgiatech, @stackfolio (acquired),

tweets.text:
It’s crazy how many absurdly high quality inference teams are raising at the seed and Series A right now. It may be the category with the highest density of talent I’ve seen in years.

At the same time, there’s some window for an M&A opportunity for majority of these teams, and conversations with all the most likely buyers have indicated desire for high amounts of experience with production systems at places like Meta / AWS/ etc as there’s a shortage of talent in this space with people that have 10+ years of experience. As well as people that won’t leave after 1-2 years.

If you’re a team in this space with a lil bit of grey hair, the opportunity to sell at a nice multiple is here and now!
